item.title: Setup
item.description:
Everything in this workshop runs on your own laptop: one Anaconda environment, one Jupyter kernel, the same for both days. Day 1 opens with a dedicated setup hour from 12:00 to 13:00, and we will work through this together then — so if anything below does not go smoothly, that is what the hour is for.

Five steps, in order, each ending with a check — so you always know whether to carry on or to ask for help.
